bug_semantics: At /dashboard/reports/forms/legacy, attacker-controlled sortBy is concatenated into the pagination base URL. Legacy Pagination replaces only the page placeholder and, through getNext, getPrevious, or getPages, writes that URL directly into a quoted href attribute. A quote-bearing sortBy value therefore exits href and injects an event-bearing HTML attribute, which executes when an authorized admin or report viewer opens the crafted request and the pagination links render.
flaw_origin: The smallest surviving public first-writer is root commit 10236caea734eeb055cd0aa18f3178bf1c6f7c0b: its initial-import pagination helper already accepts a URL and renders derived linkURL values into href without attribute escaping. Every later location in the lineage is a move, namespace/path refactor, formatting change, or styling change rather than the first write.
